title: Pull requests merged per week
description: Pull requests merged per week since February 2024, every week shown (weeks with none merged as a mark on the baseline), on a scale from 0: the 2024 average of 7.3 a week as a line, and 67 in the week of Nov 2, 2026. Titled as the team's own chart. Drawn from _code-reviews/data.js.
series: Code reviews: humans and the bot
source: code_reviews_weekly.csv (prs_merged, weekly, Feb 5, 2024 to the week of Nov 2, 2026), and the team's own chart "Pull requests merged per week" (Nov 2026), whose text the image uses. Review feedback: keep the numbers as they are, start the y-axis at 0, show every week including the zero weeks.
